description: Failure and recovery paths through a real flisk up (#1386, #3992): an unhealthy service fails startup per the health policy and its logs name the service (BP3), an interrupted flisk up is cleaned up by flisk down, after which a second flisk up succeeds (BP4), and a project compose file declaring a <project>_* external network starts cleanly because init-networks creates it (BP5). Bad service.json and missing dependsOn run without Docker in cli/src/commands/__tests__/broken-project.test.ts.
